correctness.rationale: The 10 KG(5,2) vertices and 15 edges were reconstructed, and all 3^10=59,049 spin vectors were independently enumerated into 318 nonempty (b,k,m) triples. For all 36 nonnegative-magnetization (k,m) sectors, independently found nonnegative convex weights on the seven reference triples were rationalized and verified EXACTLY for equal occupied count, no larger bond cost, no smaller magnetization. This is a global all-real-r, nonnegative-u dual certificate, not sampling of parameter space. The independence polynomial 1+10z+30z²+30z³+5z⁴ was independently enumerated; I_P(2)=461 and I_P(1)=76. The on-site expansion in x=1-s and the nonnegative edge product establish precise saturation degeneracies, with r=0 boundary covered.
